target.title: fix: count multi-failure tool summaries accurately
target.body:
Closes #102960

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users and observability consumers reading embedded agent trace metadata would see `toolSummary.failures` capped at `1` when a single turn had multiple failed tool calls.

## Why This Change Was Made

The trace summary now preserves per-tool error classification from tool execution through the attempt result and tallies those failed tool calls when building `toolSummary.failures`. The existing numeric `failures` field is preserved; this does not rename or retype the public trace shape, and the old `lastToolError` signal remains a minimum fallback for legacy/handwritten attempt data that lacks per-call error marks.

## User Impact

Dashboards, QA gates, retry logic, and plugins that consume run trace metadata can distinguish one failed tool call from multiple failed tool calls in the same turn.

## Evidence

- Source/current behavior checked: current `upstream/main` produced `toolSummary.failures` from `params.hadFailure ? 1 : 0`, with the callsite passing `Boolean(attempt.lastToolError)`.
- Focused regression coverage added for a three-tool turn with two failed tool results returning `failures: 2`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.incomplete-turn.test.ts` - passed, 2 files / 235 tests.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.types.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/types.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.incomplete-turn.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` - clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
No external dependency contract changed or relied on for this fix.
